# Pine indicator references

These 30 user-supplied files are reference material, grouped by purpose. They are
indicators/visual tools; the signal-evaluation category contains a hypothetical
simulation indicator rather than an executable broker strategy. Files were moved
without changing their contents.

The matching TypeScript implementations use the same category names under
`src/indicators/builtin/`. The application keeps the npm `lightweight-charts`
dependency and draws through its public plugin interfaces.

See [preset guides and implementation boundaries](../../doc/pine-indicators.md)
and the [attribution/license notice](../indicator-adaptations-NOTICE.txt).
